template.projectsNote: Our own goals and how they are going
template.goal: Go where we never go, and play something of our own at the end of the month.

people.name: Dad
people.description: Half an hour in the evenings, starting with the old chords

people.name: Mum
people.description: Half an hour while the house is empty: scales and one piece
people.goal: Play it with Dad at the end of the month

people.name: Roma
people.description: I read about it and tell everyone on the way to the theatre
people.goal: Tell them before it starts, not after

people.name: Yulia
people.description: What it is about and who is who — so I watch and understand
people.goal: Know the story before act one

fill.summaryAnswer:
— At the theatre Yulia sat on the edge of her seat through act one and begged for a programme at the interval.
— Dad fell asleep at the ballet, and now that is the one thing everybody remembers.
— We listened to the organ in the dark: Roma said the walls were shaking.
— On the last evening we played it together — third try, but all the way through.
fill.nextIdeas:
— A month of films: one a week, each of us picks their evening.
— A day trip to the next town, with no plan.
— Bake something difficult together, from one recipe.
— A month with no screens in the evening — let us see what we do instead.
